summary: A group calling itself 'Breach Boyz World Wide', claiming to operate from northern Iran, told KTUL in early July 2026 that it had hacked the Rogers County Jail in Claremore, Oklahoma in early March by war-driving the jail parking lot to capture Wi-Fi network access, and sent a list of nearly 30 current inmates with driver's license numbers, home addresses, Social Security numbers and contacts' phone numbers. A second email days before July 13 included an inmate booked July 10, suggesting continuing access. Rogers County said the data was accurate but that the OSBI and a network security company found no vulnerability and no proof its systems were breached.
